programmes.d: The Doctor and Peri arrive in the mining village of Killingworth in 19th century England.
The Master seeks the finest brains of the Industrial Revolution to increase his power.
The Second Doctor and Jamie visit space station Camera to speak to the scientist Dastari.
The Doctor and Peri meet Jamie and learn the Second Doctor is with the Sontarans on Earth.
The Sixth Doctor meets the Second Doctor, but events soon overtake them.
(1/4) The Doctor and Peri are startled when an image of a girl flies through the TARDIS.
(2/4) The tyrant of Karfel is getting rid of his opponents by sending them through time.
(3/4) The Doctor and Peri discover what lies at the other end of the tunnel.
(4/4) The Doctor, Peri, Vena and Herbert travel back to Kerfel.
Placed on trial by his peers, the Doctor is forced to watch events from his past.
The Doctor has an appointment with the Immortal.
With the black light converter destroyed, the Doctor fears for the planet's safety.
The Doctor is foxed by Drathro's logic.
The Doctor sees TARDIS arrive on Thoros-Beta.
The scientist Crozier keeps making promises he can't keep.
Kiv's brain rejects his new body and Crozier is forced to rethink his plan.
Sil is appalled to realize Crozier has selected Peri to be the Kiv's new host body.
A series of murders leads the Doctor to suspect something strange is happening.
The Vervoids begin to attack the crew and passengers.
The Commodore loses command of his ship.
The Doctor realizes something about the Vervoids' life span.
The Valeyard's true identity is revealed and the trial aborted.
Mel realizes that the Valeyard has created a weapon within the Matrix.
The Doctor wins a trip.
Assassins stalk Delta.
The Doctor aids alien Delta.
A newly regenerated Doctor is taken to the Rani's base by Urak the Tetrap.
The Doctor attempts to learn the secret of the Loyhargil.
The furious Rani begins to slaughter the Lakertyans, so Mel rallies the survivors.
As Mel convinces the Lakertyans to fight back, the Tetraps turn on the Rani.
Supposed to be the height of luxury, Paradise Towers is far from paradise.
With the Doctor condemned to death, Mel faces cannibalistic OAPS.
Mel and Pex play cat and mouse with the lethal cleaner robots.
Kroagnon has been reborn and is using a reanimated corpse to move around.

On Iceworld, the Doctor and Mel meet Ace, who has found herself there after a time storm.
Kane turns on his allies, as he cannot trust anyone in his search for the dragonfire...
In the archive, the Doctor discovers that Kane is from the dead world of Proamon.
In Shoreditch, 1963, the Doctor's past begins to catch up with him.
Renegade Daleks battle Imperial Daleks for control of the Hand of Omega.
The Doctor discovers the difference between the two Dalek factions.
The streets of East London shake under a civil war between the Daleks.
(1/4) The Doctor and Ace meet other visitors to the Psychic Circus on Segonax.
(2/4) Captain Cook goes to extreme measures to ensure he's not the next to face the odd family.
(3/4) Ace must stop the Chief Clown as the Doctor realizes that he is next into the ring.
(4/4) The Doctor must entertain the Gods of Ragnarok in the Dark Circus.
(1/3) Neo-Nazis are seeking the Nemesis Statue - as are Cybermen and Lady Peinforte.
